item.title: AI found 12 vulnerabilities in OpenSSL
item.description:
📝 Finding a genuine security flaw in OpenSSL is extraordinarily difficult. This makes the January 2026 release an important milestone for autonomous security systems. The DiscoveriesThe AISLE Research Team started hunting for OpenSSL vulnerabilities with our autonomous analyzer in August 2025.
